q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT(A.EMAIL) AS EMAIL FROM (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(EMAIL) AS CNT FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS A WHERE CNT > 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT(A.EMAIL) AS EMAIL FROM (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(EMAIL) AS CNT FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS A WHERE CNT > 1
explanation: Both queries are designed to find duplicate email addresses in the PERSON table. They achieve this by grouping the records by email and checking if the count of emails in each group is greater than 1.
